findings.title: Source builder call omits its required device argument
findings.detail: source_compare calls native._build_ssdg_wisig_data(args), but the consumed native function is defined as _build_ssdg_wisig_data(args, device: torch.device) in experiments/adv3b02_xuc/code/SSDG/train_ssdg.py:2757. installed(old) returns that function without adapting its signature. The first real source comparison therefore raises TypeError before the EMA checkpoint smoke or source qualification can run.
findings.minimal_fix: Pass the intended torch.device('cuda:0') as the builder's second argument.

targeted_direct_fix_re_review.scope: Only evaluate.py:20 missing-device P1 and its no-data regression check
targeted_direct_fix_re_review.fix: Pass torch.device('cuda:0') as the second source-builder argument
targeted_direct_fix_re_review.evidence: The regression obtains the actual installed builder signature, binds the source_compare call with the required CUDA device, stops before executing the builder, and asserts torch.load was never called.

scope: Direct parent-provenance, native source-builder and shared prediction/scoring interfaces consumed by this candidate
other_reviewed_boundaries: The first-seed source gate precedes target access; failure returns SOURCE_FALSIFIED, and success freezes all three fixed export configurations before prediction.
Parent source provenance is checked before checkpoint deserialization. The loaded checkpoint is validated before full strict state loading, including the own EMA head, gains and feature state.
The source comparison changes output_dir to its new run root and iterates only the original V loader; target construction is disabled by the inherited source-screen-only argument.

The prediction path consumes the frozen own EMA through the shared default-head predictor. Row scoring and final aggregation run in fresh CPU subprocesses after prediction preflight; original student correctness is paired by exact physical IDs.
review_boundary: No production edits, real checkpoint or IQ access, remote action, launch, commit, historical full review, report-completeness gate or added gate. Only this review evidence was written.
